description: Sessions that move between execution environments. Hand-written for the CLI cores. A session keeps the Flow type of the environment that started it. A command that resumes another environment's session of the same harness polls that Flow type instead of its own. Every lease holder ID names the holder's own environment: its session Flow type, holder_id.separator, and holder_id.random_hex_length random lowercase hex digits. A holder ID without the separator, or with nothing before it, was written by a release that predates this rule and names no environment. Before each model call, summary, tool call, tool task poll, and tool task cancellation, a Worker reads the session's stored lease and acts only as decision_cases say: a Worker that polls its own environment's Flow type acts unless the stored holder names another environment; a Worker that polls another environment's Flow type acts only when the stored holder ID is its own process's. Expiry plays no part in that decision. A refused tool call records failed with refused_tool_call; a refused model call or summary fails its attempt with refused_model_call. A command that takes a session over from another environment prints takeover_line: the session's environment is the one the stored holder names, or the one the session's Flow type names when no stored holder names one, and it is not this command's; when a turn was in progress, it refuses that turn's calls in its own process, cancels the turn, and prints cancelled_turn_line. Leaving another environment's session renews this holder's lease for 1 second instead of releasing it. Both lines go to standard error. --resume of a session whose Flow type is not the harness's base Flow type, '-', and 6 lowercase base36 characters exits with 2 and other_harness_error.
